<div class="ls58-widget">
  <svg
    class="ls58-svg"
    viewBox="0 0 870 619"
    preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet"
    xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
    role="img"
    aria-label="Rizadora 1 Línea 5"
  >
    <defs>
      <!-- Poleas metalizadas -->
      <linearGradient
        id="ls58-roller-metal"
        x1="15%"
        y1="0%"
        x2="85%"
        y2="100%"
      >
        <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#EFF0F2" />
        <stop offset="24%" stop-color="#E2E3E6" />
        <stop offset="43%" class="ls58-metal-stop" />
        <stop offset="56%" stop-color="#E7E8EA" />
        <stop offset="74%" class="ls58-metal-stop" />
        <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#C3C5CA" />
      </linearGradient>

      <!-- Carcasas y accesorios -->
      <linearGradient
        id="ls58-metal-gradient"
        x1="0%"
        y1="0%"
        x2="0%"
        y2="100%"
      >
        <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#ECEEF0" />
        <stop offset="18%" stop-color="#E2E4E7" />
        <stop offset="46%" class="ls58-metal-stop" />
        <stop offset="62%" stop-color="#E2E3E6" />
        <stop offset="84%" class="ls58-metal-stop" />
        <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#C6C8CD" />
      </linearGradient>

      <linearGradient
        id="ls58-side-gradient"
        x1="0%"
        y1="0%"
        x2="100%"
        y2="100%"
      >
        <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#C9CDD2" />
        <stop offset="45%" stop-color="#BFC3C9" />
        <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#AEB4BD" />
      </linearGradient>

      <linearGradient
        id="ls58-top-gradient"
        x1="0%"
        y1="0%"
        x2="100%"
        y2="100%"
      >
        <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#F0F1F3" />
        <stop offset="50%" stop-color="#E1E3E6" />
        <stop offset="100%" class="ls58-metal-stop" />
      </linearGradient>

      <!-- Depósito -->
      <linearGradient
        id="ls58-waste-gradient"
        x1="0%"
        y1="0%"
        x2="100%"
        y2="100%"
      >
        <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#A52B2B" />
        <stop offset="35%" stop-color="#930606" />
        <stop offset="75%" stop-color="#850808" />
        <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#701010" />
      </linearGradient>

      <linearGradient
        id="ls58-flap-gradient"
        x1="0%"
        y1="0%"
        x2="0%"
        y2="100%"
      >
        <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#955B5B" />
        <stop offset="55%" stop-color="#804343" />
        <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#703535" />
      </linearGradient>

      <!-- Sombras de poleas -->
      <filter
        id="ls58-roller-shadow"
        x="-30%"
        y="-30%"
        width="160%"
        height="175%"
        color-interpolation-filters="sRGB"
      >
        <feGaussianBlur
          in="SourceAlpha"
          stdDeviation="1.5"
          result="rollerAmbientBlur"
        />
        <feOffset
          in="rollerAmbientBlur"
          dx="0.3"
          dy="2"
          result="rollerAmbientOffset"
        />
        <feFlood
          flood-color="#18212D"
          flood-opacity="0.12"
          result="rollerAmbientColor"
        />
        <feComposite
          in="rollerAmbientColor"
          in2="rollerAmbientOffset"
          operator="in"
          result="rollerAmbientShadow"
        />

        <feGaussianBlur
          in="SourceAlpha"
          stdDeviation="0.4"
          result="rollerContactBlur"
        />
        <feOffset
          in="rollerContactBlur"
          dx="0"
          dy="0.65"
          result="rollerContactOffset"
        />
        <feFlood
          flood-color="#111820"
          flood-opacity="0.17"
          result="rollerContactColor"
        />
        <feComposite
          in="rollerContactColor"
          in2="rollerContactOffset"
          operator="in"
          result="rollerContactShadow"
        />

        <feMerge>
          <feMergeNode in="rollerAmbientShadow" />
          <feMergeNode in="rollerContactShadow" />
          <feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic" />
        </feMerge>
      </filter>

      <!-- Sombra ligera de los equipos -->
      <filter
        id="ls58-equipment-shadow"
        x="-15%"
        y="-15%"
        width="135%"
        height="140%"
        color-interpolation-filters="sRGB"
      >
        <feDropShadow
          dx="0.3"
          dy="1.6"
          stdDeviation="1.2"
          flood-color="#18212D"
          flood-opacity="0.14"
        />
      </filter>

      <!-- Cuerpo de válvula horizontal -->
      <g id="ls58-horizontal-valve">
        <path
          class="ls58-valve-body"
          d="M -9 -9 V 9 L 0 0 Z"
        />
        <path
          class="ls58-valve-body"
          d="M 9 -9 V 9 L 0 0 Z"
        />
      </g>

      <!-- Dispositivo vertical estriado -->

          x="-9"
          y="-14"
          width="18"
          height="28"
          rx="1"
          ry="1"
        />

        <path

        />

        <rect
          class="ls58-device-body"
          x="-11"
          y="-18"
          width="22"
          height="4"
          rx="0.5"
        />
        <rect
          class="ls58-device-body"
          x="-11"
          y="14"
          width="22"
          height="4"
          rx="0.5"
        />
      </g>

    <!-- =====================================================
         VAPOR Y CONDENSADO

         Las tuberías se interrumpen dentro de las válvulas.
